title: Am I Emotionally Unavailable? Test (12 Questions)
h1: Am I Emotionally Unavailable? 12 Questions About Closeness, Feelings & Repair

scoring.direction: higher scores indicate greater emotional availability in these answers

access.label: Emotional access
access.description: Ability to notice, name, and remain connected to one's own emotional state.

disclosure.label: Vulnerability & receiving support
disclosure.description: Ability to disclose needs, tolerate being known, and receive support without excessive self-protective distance.

receptivity.label: Responsive presence
receptivity.description: Ability to stay curious and emotionally present with another person's feelings and needs.

repair.label: Repair & return
repair.description: Ability to use space without disappearance and return to unfinished emotional conversations.

personalization.growthEdge: Lowest emotional-availability dimension is surfaced separately.
personalization.pressureGap: Compares availability in six higher-pressure scenarios with six lower-pressure scenarios to detect state-dependent shutdown.
personalization.repairSignal: Independent signal based on whether selected responses preserve accountability, directness, and a path back after distance.
personalization.combinedInsight: The two lowest dimensions are combined with repeated behavior tags to generate a pattern-specific interpretation.

sequence: Immediate reaction to being experienced as distant
Staying present with another person's emotion
Repairing after one's distance causes harm
principles: Options are psychologically plausible rather than obviously good/bad
Calm and high-pressure contexts are intentionally mixed
Questions progress from recognition to vulnerability, reciprocity, conflict, and repair

researchThemes: emotion suppression and expression in couples
